title: Aaargh!
build: PAL cassette, a crack saved with a Trilogic Expert V3.1 freezer (crackers unknown); analysed from the game's own entry at $8009

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64 (WSL2) on Windows 11, Ubuntu 26.04.1, Intel Core i7-3770, eight threads, display through WSLg
tools.emulator: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134, built with tools.py get-vice build; driven through kit/c64/vice.py; check-emulator 57 of 57

accuracy.note: Drawn from 587 handwritten and 159 generated comments: 40 handwritten (9 wrong) and 20 generated (8 wrong). Unweighted rate 28%; stratum-weighted estimate 26%. Every wrong comment was corrected, with every other comment holding the same belief, and the generated ones by template (the city screens, the order lists, the hidden list and all 39 colour RAM comments). No full audit. Recommend a full audit.
